roster.name: Guy
roster.description: A human champion with a greatsword.

sheet.stats: Human · STR 17 DEX 14 CON 12 · Speed 30 ft

features.name: Greatsword
features.text: +5, 2d6+3 slashing. Heavy and two-handed. Mastery: Graze deals 3 damage on a miss.

features.name: Great Weapon Fighting
features.text: Damage dice that roll a 1 or 2 count as 3.

features.name: Savage Attacker
features.text: Once per turn, roll a weapon hit's damage dice twice and keep the higher total.

features.name: Second Wind
features.text: Bonus action: regain 1d10+3 HP. Two uses.

features.name: Action Surge
features.text: Take one extra action this turn. One use.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.text: Champion: critical hits on a natural 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.text: Champion: Advantage on initiative.

features.name: Alert
features.text: Add your proficiency bonus to initiative.

roster.name: Elion
roster.description: A human priest of life in heavy plate.

sheet.stats: Human · WIS 17 CON 16 · Spell save DC 13, attack +5 · Speed 30 ft

features.name: Warhammer
features.text: +4, 1d8+2 bludgeoning.

features.name: Divine Spark
features.text: Channel Divinity: a creature within 30 ft regains 1d8+3 HP, or makes a CON save against 1d8+3 radiant or necrotic damage (half on a success).

features.name: Turn Undead
features.text: Channel Divinity: each undead within 30 ft makes a WIS save or is Frightened and Incapacitated, and flees. Damage ends it.

features.name: Preserve Life
features.text: Channel Divinity: divide 15 HP among Bloodied allies within 30 ft, up to half their maximum.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.text: Healing spells cast with a slot heal an extra 2 + the slot level.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Two uses.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.text: Cantrip. DEX save or 1d8 radiant. Ignores cover.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.text: Level 1. Ranged attack, 4d6 radiant; the next attack against the target has Advantage.

spells.name: Bless
spells.text: Level 1. Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attacks and saves. Concentration.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.text: Level 1. Touch: heal 2d8 + WIS.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. Heal 2d4 + WIS at range. One free cast.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. +2 AC. Concentration.

spells.name: Command
spells.text: Level 1. WIS save or the target falls Prone (Grovel).

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.text: Level 1. Undead attack the target with Disadvantage. Uses the Holy Water flask.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. Attackers must save before targeting the warded creature.

spells.name: Aid
spells.text: Level 2. Up to three allies raise their maximum and current HP by 5.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action. End a condition.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action. A force weapon strikes (1d8 + WIS force); strike again each turn as a bonus action.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.text: Cantrip. Stabilise a dying creature.

roster.name: Curogana
roster.description: A high elf sorcerer with draconic scales.

sheet.stats: High elf · CHA 18 CON 20 · Spell save DC 14, attack +6 · Speed 30 ft

features.name: Innate Sorcery
features.text: Bonus action, two uses: spell save DC +1 and Advantage on sorcerer spell attacks for a minute.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.text: Three sorcery points, spent on Metamagic.

features.name: Empowered Spell
features.text: Metamagic (1 point): reroll some low damage dice.

features.name: Heightened Spell
features.text: Metamagic (2 points): one target has Disadvantage on its save.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.text: +3 HP, and AC 10 + DEX + CHA while unarmoured.

spells.name: Sorcerous Burst
spells.text: Cantrip. Ranged attack, 1d8 damage; an 8 explodes into another d8.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.text: Cantrip. Ranged attack, 1d10 fire.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.text: Cantrip. Ranged attack, 1d8 cold, slows the target.

spells.name: Acid Splash
spells.text: Cantrip. 5-ft sphere within 60 ft; DEX save or 1d6 acid.

spells.name: Chromatic Orb
spells.text: Level 1. Ranged attack, 3d8 damage of a type you pick.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.text: Level 1. Three darts of 1d4+1 force that never miss; split them as you like. One free cast.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.text: Level 1. 15-ft cone, DEX save, 3d6 fire (half on a success).

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.text: Level 1. 15-ft cube from you, CON save, 2d8 thunder and a 10-ft push.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.text: Level 2. 10-ft sphere within 60 ft, CON save, 3d8 thunder (half on a success).

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.text: Level 2. Three fire rays, 2d6 each; split them as you like.

spells.name: Dragon's Breath
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action, concentration. A willing creature may exhale a 15-ft cone of damage as an action.

spells.name: Blur
spells.text: Level 2, concentration. Attackers have Disadvantage against you unless they perceive you with Blindsight or Truesight.

spells.name: Command
spells.text: Level 1. WIS save or the target falls Prone.

spells.name: Shield
spells.text: Level 1 reaction (automatic): +5 AC against the triggering hit.

roster.name: Skeleton
roster.description: Animated bones that fight with a shortsword and a shortbow.

features.name: Shortsword / Shortbow
features.text: +5, 1d6+3 piercing; bow 80/320 ft.

features.name: Vulnerable: bludgeoning
features.text: Takes double damage from bludgeoning.

roster.name: Zombie
roster.description: A rotting corpse animated by necromancy that lurches toward the living.

features.name: Slam
features.text: +3, 1d8+1 bludgeoning.

features.name: Undead Fortitude
features.text: At 0 HP, a CON save (DC 5 + damage) leaves it on 1 HP. Radiant damage and critical hits bypass it.

roster.name: Ghoul
roster.description: A gaunt, ravenous undead with a paralyzing claw.

features.name: Bite (x2)
features.text: +4, 1d6+2 piercing plus 1d6 necrotic.

features.name: Claw
features.text: +4, 1d4+2 slashing. A non-undead, non-elf target makes a CON save or is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

roster.name: Ghast
roster.description: A ghoul-like undead wreathed in a sickening stench.

features.name: Bite
features.text: +5, 1d8+3 piercing plus 2d8 necrotic.

features.name: Claw
features.text: +5, 2d6+3 slashing. A non-undead target makes a CON save or is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Stench
features.text: A creature starting its turn within 5 ft makes a CON save or is Poisoned until its next turn.

roster.name: Specter
roster.description: The angry spirit of a creature denied its rest.

features.name: Life Drain
features.text: +4, 2d6 necrotic; the target's HP maximum drops by the damage taken.

features.name: Resistances
features.text: Resists most physical and elemental damage. Immune to necrotic.

roster.name: Shadow
roster.description: A living darkness that drains the strength of the living.

features.name: Draining Swipe
features.text: +4, 1d6+2 necrotic; the target loses 1d4 Strength.

features.name: Vulnerable: radiant
features.text: Takes double radiant damage. Resists acid, cold, fire, lightning and thunder.

roster.name: Wight
roster.description: An armored undead warrior that drains life with blade, bow and touch.

features.name: Necrotic Sword / Bow
features.text: +4, 1d8+2 plus 1d8 necrotic. Two attacks per action.

features.name: Life Drain
features.text: CON save or 1d8+2 necrotic and the HP maximum drops by that much.

features.name: Resists necrotic
features.text: Takes half necrotic damage.

sheet.stats: Human · STR 17 DEX 14 CON 12 · Speed 30 ft

features.name: Greatsword
features.text: +5, 2d6+3 slashing. Heavy and two-handed. Mastery: Graze deals 3 damage on a miss.

features.name: Great Weapon Fighting
features.text: Damage dice that roll a 1 or 2 count as 3.

features.name: Savage Attacker
features.text: Once per turn, roll a weapon hit's damage dice twice and keep the higher total.

features.name: Second Wind
features.text: Bonus action: regain 1d10+3 HP. Two uses.

features.name: Action Surge
features.text: Take one extra action this turn. One use.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.text: Champion: critical hits on a natural 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.text: Champion: Advantage on initiative.

features.name: Alert
features.text: Add your proficiency bonus to initiative.

roster.name: Elion
roster.description: A human priest of life in heavy plate.

sheet.stats: Human · WIS 17 CON 16 · Spell save DC 13, attack +5 · Speed 30 ft

features.name: Warhammer
features.text: +4, 1d8+2 bludgeoning.

features.name: Divine Spark
features.text: Channel Divinity: a creature within 30 ft regains 1d8+3 HP, or makes a CON save against 1d8+3 radiant or necrotic damage (half on a success).

features.name: Turn Undead
features.text: Channel Divinity: each undead within 30 ft makes a WIS save or is Frightened and Incapacitated, and flees. Damage ends it.

features.name: Preserve Life
features.text: Channel Divinity: divide 15 HP among Bloodied allies within 30 ft, up to half their maximum.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.text: Healing spells cast with a slot heal an extra 2 + the slot level.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Two uses.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.text: Cantrip. DEX save or 1d8 radiant. Ignores cover.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.text: Level 1. Ranged attack, 4d6 radiant; the next attack against the target has Advantage.

spells.name: Bless
spells.text: Level 1. Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attacks and saves. Concentration.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.text: Level 1. Touch: heal 2d8 + WIS.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. Heal 2d4 + WIS at range. One free cast.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. +2 AC. Concentration.

spells.name: Command
spells.text: Level 1. WIS save or the target falls Prone (Grovel).

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.text: Level 1. Undead attack the target with Disadvantage. Uses the Holy Water flask.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. Attackers must save before targeting the warded creature.

spells.name: Aid
spells.text: Level 2. Up to three allies raise their maximum and current HP by 5.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action. End a condition.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action. A force weapon strikes (1d8 + WIS force); strike again each turn as a bonus action.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.text: Cantrip. Stabilise a dying creature.

sheet.stats: High elf · CHA 18 CON 20 · Spell save DC 14, attack +6 · Speed 30 ft

features.name: Innate Sorcery
features.text: Bonus action, two uses: spell save DC +1 and Advantage on sorcerer spell attacks for a minute.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.text: Three sorcery points, spent on Metamagic.

features.text: Metamagic (1 point): reroll some low damage dice.

features.name: Heightened Spell
features.text: Metamagic (2 points): one target has Disadvantage on its save.

features.name: Draconic Resilience

spells.name: Sorcerous Burst
spells.text: Cantrip. Ranged attack, 1d8 damage; an 8 explodes into another d8.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.text: Cantrip. Ranged attack, 1d10 fire.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.text: Cantrip. Ranged attack, 1d8 cold, slows the target.

spells.name: Acid Splash
spells.text: Cantrip. 5-ft sphere within 60 ft; DEX save or 1d6 acid.

spells.name: Chromatic Orb
spells.text: Level 1. Ranged attack, 3d8 damage of a type you pick.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.text: Level 1. Three darts of 1d4+1 force that never miss; split them as you like. One free cast.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.text: Level 1. 15-ft cone, DEX save, 3d6 fire (half on a success).

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.text: Level 1. 15-ft cube from you, CON save, 2d8 thunder and a 10-ft push.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.text: Level 2. 10-ft sphere within 60 ft, CON save, 3d8 thunder (half on a success).

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.text: Level 2. Three fire rays, 2d6 each; split them as you like.

spells.name: Dragon's Breath
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action, concentration. A willing creature may exhale a 15-ft cone of damage as an action.

spells.name: Blur
spells.text: Level 2, concentration. Attackers have Disadvantage against you unless they perceive you with Blindsight or Truesight.

spells.name: Command
spells.text: Level 1. WIS save or the target falls Prone.

spells.name: Shield
spells.text: Level 1 reaction (automatic): +5 AC against the triggering hit.

log.text: Place figures, then Start combat. Each square is 5 feet.
Guy: Greatsword hits Zombie (attack d20(16) + 5 = 21); d6(4 + 5) + 3 = 12 → 12 slashing damage.
Zombie's Undead Fortitude keeps it standing at 1 HP.
Specter: life drain hits Guy (attack d20(18) + 4 = 22); d6(1 + 4) = 5 → 5 necrotic damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Specter; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Shadow; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Wight; d8(6 + 4 + 8) = 18 → 18 thunder damage.
Shadow: draining swipe misses Guy (attack d20(8) + 4 = 12).

log.text: Place figures, then Start combat. Each square is 5 feet.
Guy: Greatsword hits Zombie (attack d20(16) + 5 = 21); d6(4 + 5) + 3 = 12 → 12 slashing damage.
Zombie's Undead Fortitude keeps it standing at 1 HP.
Specter: life drain hits Guy (attack d20(18) + 4 = 22); d6(1 + 4) = 5 → 5 necrotic damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Specter; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Shadow; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Wight; d8(6 + 4 + 8) = 18 → 18 thunder damage.
Shadow: draining swipe misses Guy (attack d20(8) + 4 = 12).
Wight: necrotic bow misses Guy (attack d20(10) + 4 = 14).
Wight: necrotic bow hits Guy (attack d20(14) + 4 = 18); d8(2) + 2 = 4 → 4 piercing damage.
Skeleton fails the save (WIS save d20(11) - 1 = 10 vs DC 13).
Ghoul resists (WIS save d20(17) = 17 vs DC 13).
Elion: spell.spiritual weapon hits Ghoul (attack d20(14) + 5 = 19); d8(4) + 3 = 7 → 7 force damage.

sheet.stats: High elf · CHA 18 CON 20 · Spell save DC 14, attack +6 · Speed 30 ft

features.name: Innate Sorcery
features.text: Bonus action, two uses: spell save DC +1 and Advantage on sorcerer spell attacks for a minute.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.text: Three sorcery points, spent on Metamagic.

features.name: Empowered Spell
features.text: Metamagic (1 point): reroll some low damage dice.

features.name: Heightened Spell
features.text: Metamagic (2 points): one target has Disadvantage on its save.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.text: +3 HP, and AC 10 + DEX + CHA while unarmoured.

spells.name: Sorcerous Burst
spells.text: Cantrip. Ranged attack, 1d8 damage; an 8 explodes into another d8.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.text: Cantrip. Ranged attack, 1d10 fire.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.text: Cantrip. Ranged attack, 1d8 cold, slows the target.

spells.name: Acid Splash
spells.text: Cantrip. 5-ft sphere within 60 ft; DEX save or 1d6 acid.

spells.name: Chromatic Orb
spells.text: Level 1. Ranged attack, 3d8 damage of a type you pick.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.text: Level 1. Three darts of 1d4+1 force that never miss; split them as you like. One free cast.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.text: Level 1. 15-ft cone, DEX save, 3d6 fire (half on a success).

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.text: Level 1. 15-ft cube from you, CON save, 2d8 thunder and a 10-ft push.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.text: Level 2. 10-ft sphere within 60 ft, CON save, 3d8 thunder (half on a success).

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.text: Level 2. Three fire rays, 2d6 each; split them as you like.

spells.name: Dragon's Breath
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action, concentration. A willing creature may exhale a 15-ft cone of damage as an action.

spells.name: Blur
spells.text: Level 2, concentration. Attackers have Disadvantage against you unless they perceive you with Blindsight or Truesight.

spells.name: Command
spells.text: Level 1. WIS save or the target falls Prone.

spells.name: Shield
spells.text: Level 1 reaction (automatic): +5 AC against the triggering hit.

units.name: Shadow
units.description: A living darkness that drains the strength of the living.

features.name: Draining Swipe
features.text: +4, 1d6+2 necrotic; the target loses 1d4 Strength.

features.name: Vulnerable: radiant
features.text: Takes double radiant damage. Resists acid, cold, fire, lightning and thunder.

units.name: Wight
units.description: An armored undead warrior that drains life with blade, bow and touch.

features.name: Necrotic Sword / Bow
features.text: +4, 1d8+2 plus 1d8 necrotic. Two attacks per action.

features.name: Life Drain
features.text: CON save or 1d8+2 necrotic and the HP maximum drops by that much.

features.name: Resists necrotic
features.text: Takes half necrotic damage.

units.name: Skeleton
units.description: Animated bones that fight with a shortsword and a shortbow.

features.name: Shortsword / Shortbow
features.text: +5, 1d6+3 piercing; bow 80/320 ft.

features.name: Vulnerable: bludgeoning
features.text: Takes double damage from bludgeoning.

units.name: Elion
units.description: A human priest of life in heavy plate.

sheet.stats: Human · WIS 17 CON 16 · Spell save DC 13, attack +5 · Speed 30 ft

features.name: Warhammer
features.text: +4, 1d8+2 bludgeoning.

features.name: Divine Spark
features.text: Channel Divinity: a creature within 30 ft regains 1d8+3 HP, or makes a CON save against 1d8+3 radiant or necrotic damage (half on a success).

features.name: Turn Undead
features.text: Channel Divinity: each undead within 30 ft makes a WIS save or is Frightened and Incapacitated, and flees. Damage ends it.

features.name: Preserve Life
features.text: Channel Divinity: divide 15 HP among Bloodied allies within 30 ft, up to half their maximum.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.text: Healing spells cast with a slot heal an extra 2 + the slot level.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Two uses.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.text: Cantrip. DEX save or 1d8 radiant. Ignores cover.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.text: Level 1. Ranged attack, 4d6 radiant; the next attack against the target has Advantage.

spells.name: Bless
spells.text: Level 1. Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attacks and saves. Concentration.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.text: Level 1. Touch: heal 2d8 + WIS.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. Heal 2d4 + WIS at range. One free cast.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. +2 AC. Concentration.

spells.name: Command
spells.text: Level 1. WIS save or the target falls Prone (Grovel).

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.text: Level 1. Undead attack the target with Disadvantage. Uses the Holy Water flask.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. Attackers must save before targeting the warded creature.

spells.name: Aid
spells.text: Level 2. Up to three allies raise their maximum and current HP by 5.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action. End a condition.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action. A force weapon strikes (1d8 + WIS force); strike again each turn as a bonus action.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.text: Cantrip. Stabilise a dying creature.

log.text: Place figures, then Start combat. Each square is 5 feet.
Guy: Greatsword hits Zombie (attack d20(16) + 5 = 21); d6(4 + 5) + 3 = 12 → 12 slashing damage.
Zombie's Undead Fortitude keeps it standing at 1 HP.
Specter: life drain hits Guy (attack d20(18) + 4 = 22); d6(1 + 4) = 5 → 5 necrotic damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Specter; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Shadow; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Wight; d8(6 + 4 + 8) = 18 → 18 thunder damage.
Shadow: draining swipe misses Guy (attack d20(8) + 4 = 12).
Wight: necrotic bow misses Guy (attack d20(10) + 4 = 14).
Wight: necrotic bow hits Guy (attack d20(14) + 4 = 18); d8(2) + 2 = 4 → 4 piercing damage.
Skeleton fails the save (WIS save d20(11) - 1 = 10 vs DC 13).
Ghoul resists (WIS save d20(17) = 17 vs DC 13).
Elion: spell.spiritual weapon hits Ghoul (attack d20(14) + 5 = 19); d8(4) + 3 = 7 → 7 force damage.
Guy: Greatsword hits Zombie (attack d20(10) + 5 = 15); d6(5 + 4) + 3 = 12 → 12 slashing damage.
Zombie's Undead Fortitude keeps it standing at 1 HP.
Guy uses Second Wind: d10(1) + 3 = 4 healing.

log.text: Place figures, then Start combat. Each square is 5 feet.
Guy: Greatsword hits Zombie (attack d20(16) + 5 = 21); d6(4 + 5) + 3 = 12 → 12 slashing damage.
Zombie's Undead Fortitude keeps it standing at 1 HP.
Specter: life drain hits Guy (attack d20(18) + 4 = 22); d6(1 + 4) = 5 → 5 necrotic damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Specter; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Shadow; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Wight; d8(6 + 4 + 8) = 18 → 18 thunder damage.
Shadow: draining swipe misses Guy (attack d20(8) + 4 = 12).
Wight: necrotic bow misses Guy (attack d20(10) + 4 = 14).
Wight: necrotic bow hits Guy (attack d20(14) + 4 = 18); d8(2) + 2 = 4 → 4 piercing damage.
Skeleton fails the save (WIS save d20(11) - 1 = 10 vs DC 13).
Ghoul resists (WIS save d20(17) = 17 vs DC 13).
Elion: spell.spiritual weapon hits Ghoul (attack d20(14) + 5 = 19); d8(4) + 3 = 7 → 7 force damage.
Guy: Greatsword hits Zombie (attack d20(10) + 5 = 15); d6(5 + 4) + 3 = 12 → 12 slashing damage.
Zombie's Undead Fortitude keeps it standing at 1 HP.
Guy uses Second Wind: d10(1) + 3 = 4 healing.
Ghast: bite hits Guy (attack d20(16) + 5 = 21); d8(4) + 3 = 7 → 7 piercing damage.
Ghoul: bite hits Curogana (attack d20(18) + 4 = 22); d6(6) + 2 = 8 → 8 piercing damage.

log.text: Place figures, then Start combat. Each square is 5 feet.
Guy: Greatsword hits Zombie (attack d20(16) + 5 = 21); d6(4 + 5) + 3 = 12 → 12 slashing damage.
Zombie's Undead Fortitude keeps it standing at 1 HP.
Specter: life drain hits Guy (attack d20(18) + 4 = 22); d6(1 + 4) = 5 → 5 necrotic damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Specter; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Shadow; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Wight; d8(6 + 4 + 8) = 18 → 18 thunder damage.
Shadow: draining swipe misses Guy (attack d20(8) + 4 = 12).
Wight: necrotic bow misses Guy (attack d20(10) + 4 = 14).
Wight: necrotic bow hits Guy (attack d20(14) + 4 = 18); d8(2) + 2 = 4 → 4 piercing damage.
Skeleton fails the save (WIS save d20(11) - 1 = 10 vs DC 13).
Ghoul resists (WIS save d20(17) = 17 vs DC 13).
Elion: spell.spiritual weapon hits Ghoul (attack d20(14) + 5 = 19); d8(4) + 3 = 7 → 7 force damage.
Guy: Greatsword hits Zombie (attack d20(10) + 5 = 15); d6(5 + 4) + 3 = 12 → 12 slashing damage.
Zombie's Undead Fortitude keeps it standing at 1 HP.
Guy uses Second Wind: d10(1) + 3 = 4 healing.
Ghast: bite hits Guy (attack d20(16) + 5 = 21); d8(4) + 3 = 7 → 7 piercing damage.
Ghoul: bite hits Curogana (attack d20(18) + 4 = 22); d6(6) + 2 = 8 → 8 piercing damage.
Specter: life drain misses Elion (attack d20(12) + 4 = 16).

log.text: Place figures, then Start combat. Each square is 5 feet.
Guy: Greatsword hits Zombie (attack d20(16) + 5 = 21); d6(4 + 5) + 3 = 12 → 12 slashing damage.
Zombie's Undead Fortitude keeps it standing at 1 HP.
Specter: life drain hits Guy (attack d20(18) + 4 = 22); d6(1 + 4) = 5 → 5 necrotic damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Specter; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Shadow; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Wight; d8(6 + 4 + 8) = 18 → 18 thunder damage.
Shadow: draining swipe misses Guy (attack d20(8) + 4 = 12).
Wight: necrotic bow misses Guy (attack d20(10) + 4 = 14).
Wight: necrotic bow hits Guy (attack d20(14) + 4 = 18); d8(2) + 2 = 4 → 4 piercing damage.
Skeleton fails the save (WIS save d20(11) - 1 = 10 vs DC 13).
Ghoul resists (WIS save d20(17) = 17 vs DC 13).
Elion: spell.spiritual weapon hits Ghoul (attack d20(14) + 5 = 19); d8(4) + 3 = 7 → 7 force damage.
Guy: Greatsword hits Zombie (attack d20(10) + 5 = 15); d6(5 + 4) + 3 = 12 → 12 slashing damage.
Zombie's Undead Fortitude keeps it standing at 1 HP.
Guy uses Second Wind: d10(1) + 3 = 4 healing.
Ghast: bite hits Guy (attack d20(16) + 5 = 21); d8(4) + 3 = 7 → 7 piercing damage.
Ghoul: bite hits Curogana (attack d20(18) + 4 = 22); d6(6) + 2 = 8 → 8 piercing damage.
Specter: life drain misses Elion (attack d20(12) + 4 = 16).
Curogana: shatter hits Zombie; d8(5 + 7 + 7) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Skeleton; d8(5 + 7 + 7) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Elion; d8(5 + 7 + 7) = 19 → 19 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Ghast; d8(5 + 7 + 7) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Specter; d8(5 + 7 + 7) = 19 → 19 thunder damage.

features.name: Warhammer
features.text: +4, 1d8+2 bludgeoning.

features.name: Divine Spark
features.text: Channel Divinity: a creature within 30 ft regains 1d8+3 HP, or makes a CON save against 1d8+3 radiant or necrotic damage (half on a success).

features.text: Channel Divinity: each undead within 30 ft makes a WIS save or is Frightened and Incapacitated, and flees. Damage ends it.

features.text: Channel Divinity: divide 15 HP among Bloodied allies within 30 ft, up to half their maximum.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.text: Healing spells cast with a slot heal an extra 2 + the slot level.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Two uses.

spells.text: Cantrip. DEX save or 1d8 radiant. Ignores cover.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.text: Level 1. Ranged attack, 4d6 radiant; the next attack against the target has Advantage.

spells.name: Bless
spells.text: Level 1. Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attacks and saves. Concentration.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.text: Level 1. Touch: heal 2d8 + WIS.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. Heal 2d4 + WIS at range. One free cast.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. +2 AC. Concentration.

spells.name: Command
spells.text: Level 1. WIS save or the target falls Prone (Grovel).

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.text: Level 1. Undead attack the target with Disadvantage. Uses the Holy Water flask.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. Attackers must save before targeting the warded creature.

spells.name: Aid
spells.text: Level 2. Up to three allies raise their maximum and current HP by 5.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action. End a condition.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action. A force weapon strikes (1d8 + WIS force); strike again each turn as a bonus action.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.text: Cantrip. Stabilise a dying creature.

log.text: Place figures, then Start combat. Each square is 5 feet.
Guy: Greatsword hits Zombie (attack d20(16) + 5 = 21); d6(4 + 5) + 3 = 12 → 12 slashing damage.
Zombie's Undead Fortitude keeps it standing at 1 HP.
Specter: life drain hits Guy (attack d20(18) + 4 = 22); d6(1 + 4) = 5 → 5 necrotic damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Specter; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Shadow; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Wight; d8(6 + 4 + 8) = 18 → 18 thunder damage.
Shadow: draining swipe misses Guy (attack d20(8) + 4 = 12).
Wight: necrotic bow misses Guy (attack d20(10) + 4 = 14).
Wight: necrotic bow hits Guy (attack d20(14) + 4 = 18); d8(2) + 2 = 4 → 4 piercing damage.
Skeleton fails the save (WIS save d20(11) - 1 = 10 vs DC 13).
Ghoul resists (WIS save d20(17) = 17 vs DC 13).
Elion: spell.spiritual weapon hits Ghoul (attack d20(14) + 5 = 19); d8(4) + 3 = 7 → 7 force damage.
Guy: Greatsword hits Zombie (attack d20(10) + 5 = 15); d6(5 + 4) + 3 = 12 → 12 slashing damage.
Zombie's Undead Fortitude keeps it standing at 1 HP.
Guy uses Second Wind: d10(1) + 3 = 4 healing.
Ghast: bite hits Guy (attack d20(16) + 5 = 21); d8(4) + 3 = 7 → 7 piercing damage.
Ghoul: bite hits Curogana (attack d20(18) + 4 = 22); d6(6) + 2 = 8 → 8 piercing damage.
Specter: life drain misses Elion (attack d20(12) + 4 = 16).
Curogana: shatter hits Zombie; d8(5 + 7 + 7) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Skeleton; d8(5 + 7 + 7) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Elion; d8(5 + 7 + 7) = 19 → 19 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Ghast; d8(5 + 7 + 7) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Specter; d8(5 + 7 + 7) = 19 → 19 thunder damage.
Shadow: draining swipe hits Elion (attack d20(17) + 4 = 21); d6(2) + 2 = 4 → 4 necrotic damage.

log.text: Place figures, then Start combat. Each square is 5 feet.
Guy: Greatsword hits Zombie (attack d20(16) + 5 = 21); d6(4 + 5) + 3 = 12 → 12 slashing damage.
Zombie's Undead Fortitude keeps it standing at 1 HP.
Specter: life drain hits Guy (attack d20(18) + 4 = 22); d6(1 + 4) = 5 → 5 necrotic damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Specter; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Shadow; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Wight; d8(6 + 4 + 8) = 18 → 18 thunder damage.
Shadow: draining swipe misses Guy (attack d20(8) + 4 = 12).
Wight: necrotic bow misses Guy (attack d20(10) + 4 = 14).
Wight: necrotic bow hits Guy (attack d20(14) + 4 = 18); d8(2) + 2 = 4 → 4 piercing damage.
Skeleton fails the save (WIS save d20(11) - 1 = 10 vs DC 13).
Ghoul resists (WIS save d20(17) = 17 vs DC 13).
Elion: spell.spiritual weapon hits Ghoul (attack d20(14) + 5 = 19); d8(4) + 3 = 7 → 7 force damage.
Guy: Greatsword hits Zombie (attack d20(10) + 5 = 15); d6(5 + 4) + 3 = 12 → 12 slashing damage.
Zombie's Undead Fortitude keeps it standing at 1 HP.
Guy uses Second Wind: d10(1) + 3 = 4 healing.
Ghast: bite hits Guy (attack d20(16) + 5 = 21); d8(4) + 3 = 7 → 7 piercing damage.
Ghoul: bite hits Curogana (attack d20(18) + 4 = 22); d6(6) + 2 = 8 → 8 piercing damage.
Specter: life drain misses Elion (attack d20(12) + 4 = 16).
Curogana: shatter hits Zombie; d8(5 + 7 + 7) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Skeleton; d8(5 + 7 + 7) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Elion; d8(5 + 7 + 7) = 19 → 19 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Ghast; d8(5 + 7 + 7) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Specter; d8(5 + 7 + 7) = 19 → 19 thunder damage.
Shadow: draining swipe hits Elion (attack d20(17) + 4 = 21); d6(2) + 2 = 4 → 4 necrotic damage.
Wight: necrotic bow hits Elion (attack d20(7 | 18*) + 4 = 22); d8(4) + 2 = 6 → 6 piercing damage.
Wight: necrotic bow misses Curogana (attack d20(17) + 4 = 21).
Skeleton: shortsword hits Curogana (attack d20(19) + 5 = 24); d6(3) + 3 = 6 → 6 piercing damage.
Ghast: bite hits Elion (attack d20(20* | 1) + 5 = 25); d8(7 + 3) + 3 = 13 → 13 piercing damage.

log.text: Place figures, then Start combat. Each square is 5 feet.
Guy: Greatsword hits Zombie (attack d20(16) + 5 = 21); d6(4 + 5) + 3 = 12 → 12 slashing damage.
Zombie's Undead Fortitude keeps it standing at 1 HP.
Specter: life drain hits Guy (attack d20(18) + 4 = 22); d6(1 + 4) = 5 → 5 necrotic damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Specter; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Shadow; d8(6 + 4 + 8) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Wight; d8(6 + 4 + 8) = 18 → 18 thunder damage.
Shadow: draining swipe misses Guy (attack d20(8) + 4 = 12).
Wight: necrotic bow misses Guy (attack d20(10) + 4 = 14).
Wight: necrotic bow hits Guy (attack d20(14) + 4 = 18); d8(2) + 2 = 4 → 4 piercing damage.
Skeleton fails the save (WIS save d20(11) - 1 = 10 vs DC 13).
Ghoul resists (WIS save d20(17) = 17 vs DC 13).
Elion: spell.spiritual weapon hits Ghoul (attack d20(14) + 5 = 19); d8(4) + 3 = 7 → 7 force damage.
Guy: Greatsword hits Zombie (attack d20(10) + 5 = 15); d6(5 + 4) + 3 = 12 → 12 slashing damage.
Zombie's Undead Fortitude keeps it standing at 1 HP.
Guy uses Second Wind: d10(1) + 3 = 4 healing.
Ghast: bite hits Guy (attack d20(16) + 5 = 21); d8(4) + 3 = 7 → 7 piercing damage.
Ghoul: bite hits Curogana (attack d20(18) + 4 = 22); d6(6) + 2 = 8 → 8 piercing damage.
Specter: life drain misses Elion (attack d20(12) + 4 = 16).
Curogana: shatter hits Zombie; d8(5 + 7 + 7) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Skeleton; d8(5 + 7 + 7) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Elion; d8(5 + 7 + 7) = 19 → 19 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Ghast; d8(5 + 7 + 7) / 2 = 9 → 9 thunder damage.
Curogana: shatter hits Specter; d8(5 + 7 + 7) = 19 → 19 thunder damage.
Shadow: draining swipe hits Elion (attack d20(17) + 4 = 21); d6(2) + 2 = 4 → 4 necrotic damage.
Wight: necrotic bow hits Elion (attack d20(7 | 18*) + 4 = 22); d8(4) + 2 = 6 → 6 piercing damage.
Wight: necrotic bow misses Curogana (attack d20(17) + 4 = 21).
Skeleton: shortsword hits Curogana (attack d20(19) + 5 = 24); d6(3) + 3 = 6 → 6 piercing damage.
Ghast: bite hits Elion (attack d20(20* | 1) + 5 = 25); d8(7 + 3) + 3 = 13 → 13 piercing damage.
Ghoul: bite hits Curogana (attack d20(18) + 4 = 22); d6(2) + 2 = 4 → 4 piercing damage.
Curogana: thunderwave hits Ghoul; d8(8 + 6) = 14 → 14 thunder damage.
Curogana: thunderwave hits Shadow; d8(8 + 6) = 14 → 14 thunder damage.
Curogana: thunderwave hits Skeleton; d8(8 + 6) = 14 → 14 thunder damage.
